# Radu Bebe — enemies, weapons, and hints

- Original source: [Radu Bebe — enemies, weapons, and hints](https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/pc/562021-robin-hood-the-legend-of-sherwood/faqs/23711)
- Author / publication: Radu Bebe (Radu_Bebe) / GameFAQs
- Language / date: English; version 1.0, updated 2003-06-02
- Access: Page text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

A complementary mechanics FAQ rather than a complete campaign route. It organizes observations into changes from earlier tactics games, enemy categories, weapons, and practical hints.

The author describes assigning unused recruits to production or training in Sherwood, and taking generic recruits on easier ambushes while heroes improve their skills. Archery training reportedly requires an arrow in the trainee's inventory without consuming it. Recruitment is associated with the proportion of enemies spared.

Enemy notes distinguish officers, ranged soldiers, heavily armored opponents, mounted enemies, and civilians who raise alarms. Weapon notes compare lethal and nonlethal options, including the difference between Robin's punch and Little John's stronger knockout.

**Limitations:** the author explicitly invents some enemy names, estimates mission totals, and marks several observations as uncertain. Numeric damage and training claims need verification against the relevant difficulty and game version before becoming implementation requirements.
